body:
I'll start by reading the CONTRACT to understand the exact requirements.

Let me explore the captured docs structure and key source files.

The per-method files are flat in `pages/api/`. Let me count and examine key source files with line numbers.

Now I understand: `bots/api.md:N` maps to `pages/bots_api.md.md` (472 lines). Let me read the full main API doc in chunks and key transport docs.

Now let me examine key per-method pages and transport docs with line numbers.

Now let me read the webhooks, self-signed, and serverless guides.

Let me check for any verifier script to settle the citation-file mapping.

Now I understand the verifier fully. Let me gather remaining facts: changelog 10.4, MTProto/TDLib mentions, formatting/parse modes, and a few method families.

Let me verify the method/type page counts and the reference structure for chapter 03.

Let me verify the local-server 503 claim and a few remaining details before writing.

I have all verified facts. Now writing the seven chapters.

Chapter 01 is short. Let me verify additional lines and expand it.

Let me verify a few citations and fix a potentially unresolved path.

The edit scrambled line positions. Let me re-read chapter 03 fully.

I'll rewrite chapter 03 cleanly to restore structure and fix citations.

Let me verify a few security-related lines before writing chapter 05.

Let me verify and fix one webhooks citation in chapter 05.

Let me verify exact webhook example line numbers before chapter 06.

Chapter 07 is slightly over the requested ceiling. Let me trim it.

Let me audit my own citations for resolution (local check only, not the parent's verifier).

Let me double-check the changelog line numbers used in chapter 01.

All seven assigned chapters are complete in `/home/one/projects/one/ai-guides/protocols/telegram_bots_guide/`:

| File | Bytes |
|---|---|
| `01-api-boundary-and-limits.md` | 6,668 |
| `02-architecture-and-update-loop.md` | 6,874 |
| `03-api-reference-map.md` | 6,940 |
| `04-antiflood-and-limits.md` | 6,519 |
| `05-security-and-tokens.md` | 6,762 |
| `06-webhooks-and-deployment.md` | 7,113 |
| `07-long-polling.md` | 7,312 |

Each has the required `# NN - Title` first line and `## Sources` as the last section, 6–8 full official URLs in Sources, and dense English prose with inline `bots/...:line` citations. Every citation was checked against the captured files under `/tmp/telegram-research` (file exists, line in bounds), and every cited line was read with `sed`/`nl` before writing. No other files were touched, and the parent's global verifier was not run.

Two honest gaps are marked `not verified` in-text: no captured official line documents 502/503 Bot API semantics, and the paid-broadcast Stars/MAU prerequisite differs between `bots/api.md:217` and `bots/faq.md:131` (both cited).
